consumer_path: TSKV8Adapter.ingest_input observes the query and the attached EpisodicMemoryStore retrieves candidates
CognitiveState.memory.episodic_ids is the explicit allowlist for retrieved record IDs
JointEpisodeReadV1 verifies the selected hit, receipt digest, owner/scope/session revision, query cue and input identity
record event/assembly IDs map through Event lineage and per-input percept tick spans to one historical frame
current query plus the selected memory frame enter the same V4 byte/workspace evidence cache
next_logits_from_episode and generate_from_episode use that cache; query-only lesion preserves the same query and removes only the retrieved memory frame

wire_format.migration: legacy V1 payloads and native components restore to V2; old bindings with no percept tick span remain readable but ambiguous memory source reads fail closed

source_identity_fix: JointInputBinding stores the start/end percept observation ticks for each actual input frame. Reused event/assembly identities are resolved only when the record tick or linked CognitiveState.Event interval identifies one frame.

causal_evidence.actual_adapter_query: actual TSKV8Adapter.ingest_input(learn=False) produced the current query trace and populated episodic_ids from the attached store
causal_evidence.record_setup: one experienced external memory record tied to a prior adapter input assembly; test fixture writes the record, so successful memory writing/credit is not claimed

authorization_boundary.production_privacy_isolation: not proven; store attachment and CognitiveState construction are caller-trusted

coverage_boundary.cross_session_recall: not integrated; new_session clears input bindings and records do not persist raw source bytes

architecture_review: source identity ambiguity and memory-specific causal isolation findings addressed; caller-trusted owner/scope and cross-session-source caveats remain
next_development_step: N177.2-T3: connect one-step WorldDynamicsLearner action-conditioned predictions and ExecutiveController selection to the same joint frame and V4 language consumer
